name: Bondex Supply Chain Management Co., Ltd.
summary: Bondex Supply Chain Management Co., Ltd. provides logistics services in China. The company offers basic segmented logistics services, such as sea freight services, land transport services, air freight services, railway transport services, customs affairs services, and warehouse services; lean contract logistics services for automobile industry, fresh and perishable goods, expo logistics, project and bulk logistics, cross-border e-commerce; lean supply chain logistics services for the semiconductor industry; and supply chain trade services. It also provides client-oriented logistics services, including door-door delivery, customs affairs management, and warehousing and distribution to various industries, including electronics, semiconductors, overseas projects, automobiles, cross-border e-commerce, fresh food, fashion consumer goods, etc. Bondex Supply Chain Management Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Qingdao, China.
